author: BourbonBonobo
body:
Hello Avicadians!

  I was thinking about making a forum game! It's been a while since iv'e actually made a good forum post, and i thought that a game would be a fun way to get back involved with the forums! So the game works like this, I will describe a certain celebrity, without saying their name, and you guys have to guess who it is! This could be anyone! For example I could say this:

This person is plays Captain America in the Avengers movies!

Answerer:

Oh, It's Chris Evans!!! (this one is pretty simple, just trying to convey the idea)

Get how it works?? Ok so here is the first person I want to throw out there!

This person is an actress who has a thick colombian accent and stars in many TV shows, such as Modern Family!

Who is this person ^^^?

Hope you guys enjoy the game!!

-Wreck
